title: Air Niugini plane makes emergency landing at Davao airport

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — An Air Niugini plane carrying 146 passengers and crew members made an emergency landing at Davao International Airport early Saturday, Nov. 21, the Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines (Caap) reported. According to Caap, the Boeing aircraft was traveling from Hong Kong to Papua New Guinea when it made the emergency landing at around 12:08 a.m. All 137 passengers and nine crew members aboard the aircraft were reportedly safe. Caap did not provide further details about what prompted the emergency landing.
